script.spoken: USS Miami was destroyed by fire during an overhaul. It spread through crew, command and torpedo spaces, and burned for twelve hours. The submarine was in overhaul. The first report blamed a vacuum cleaner. Then a shipyard worker confessed. He lit rags on a bunk so he could leave work early. He was sentenced to more than seventeen years. The submarine was decommissioned instead of repaired.
